Short answer: you don’t need to panic‑buy, but if you can realistically place most of the ~$60k of gear in service inside the current higher‑bonus window, accelerating those purchases will likely provide a meaningful one‑year deduction — otherwise it’s reasonable to stagger purchases and plan around hiring/turnover.
